actions.name: createBarPlot
actions.summary: Creates a complete vertical, horizontal, aggregate, ranged, grouped, or stacked bar chart through the existing bar policies.
useWhen: Use this action when you need to create a complete vertical, horizontal, aggregate, ranged, grouped, or stacked bar chart through the existing bar policies.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action when an existing owned resource should be revised, or when required inputs leave multiple compatible sources unnamed.
requiredState: A Canvas and one compatible source dataset must already exist; multiple datasets require an explicit data identifier.

parameterNotes.description: Assigns a stable resource identifier so later actions can target this exact owner without relying on inference.
Names the source dataset used by this action instead of relying on the current or uniquely compatible dataset.
Defines the horizontal field or x-role options used to construct or revise the requested result.
Defines the vertical field or y-role options used to construct or revise the requested result.
Names the coordinate resource used for position materialization when inference is not unique.
Controls the axes, grids, and legends created for the completed result; false suppresses guide creation.
Sets the finite logical width used by the Canvas, mark, guide, or component owned by this action.

semantic: Creates a complete vertical, horizontal, aggregate, ranged, grouped, or stacked bar chart through the existing bar policies. The changed semantic owner or assignment is structurally copied into the returned program.
graphic: Materializes or rematerializes the affected backend-neutral graphical subtree when the required semantic state is complete.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

commonErrors.problem: Leaving multiple compatible datasets, marks, scales, coordinates, or owners unnamed causes an ambiguity error instead of first-item selection.
commonErrors.fix: Pass the exact public identifier required by the signature, or create the missing prerequisite before calling this action.
